# The validation rules of the SDK: each check that rejects a configuration or an
# argument before a request is sent, one per line as <ID> <message>, sorted by ID.
# TestValidationRules (validation_rules_test.go) fails when internal/validate differs.
# After an intended change, rewrite this file with
# go test -run TestValidationRules -update . and review the diff. apisurface's diff mode
# counts an ID that is new here as a breaking change.
config.api-key.empty the API key is empty; pass a Permit API key, or leave the option out to read PERMIT_API_KEY
config.api-key.missing no API key; pass WithAPIKey, or set PERMIT_API_KEY
config.http-client.nil the *http.Client is nil; pass a client, or leave the option out to use one of the SDK's own
config.option.zero the Option is the zero value; build options with the With functions
config.retry.max-backoff.negative MaxBackoff is less than zero; give 0 or more, where 0 is the default, 5 seconds
config.retry.max-retries.negative MaxRetries is less than zero; give 0 or more, where 0 sends each request once
config.scope.environment-without-project the environment is set and the project is empty; give the project that the environment belongs to
config.scope.project-empty the project is empty; give the key or ID of the project, or leave WithScope out to use the API key's scope
config.timeout.not-positive the timeout must be more than zero, such as 30 * time.Second
config.url.empty the URL is empty; leave the option out to read the environment variable or to use the default
config.url.fragment the URL has a fragment (#...); give the URL without it
config.url.host the URL has no host; give one, such as api.permit.io in https://api.permit.io
config.url.parse the URL does not parse; check that it starts with http:// or https://, that its port is a number, and that it has no spaces and no % without two hex digits after it
config.url.query the URL has a query (?...); give the URL without it
config.url.scheme the URL must start with http:// or https://
config.url.userinfo the URL has a user name or a password; give the API key with WithAPIKey or PERMIT_API_KEY instead
copy-result.wait.negative Wait is less than zero; give 0 to read the task without a wait, or a wait of up to 60 seconds
decision.filter.empty the filter has no keys; give at least one, or leave the option out to get the permissions of every tenant, resource or resource type
decision.option.nil the PermissionsOption is nil; build options with the With functions, such as WithTenants
decision.option.zero the CheckOption is the zero value; build options with the With functions, such as WithDecisionContext
decision.resource-type.empty the resource type is empty; give the key of the resource type, such as document, as the PDP rejects a request without one
decision.url.empty the URL is empty; give the URL of the request to check, as the PDP rejects a request without one
decision.user-key.empty the user key is empty; give the key of the user, as the PDP rejects a request without one
list.attribute-filter.name-empty the attribute filter names no attribute; build it with AttributeEquals and the name of the attribute
list.attribute-filter.not-finite the value of the attribute filter is NaN or an infinity, which the API does not read as a number; give a finite number
list.page.negative Page is less than zero; give 0 or 1 for the first page, or the number of a later page
list.per-page.negative PerPage is less than zero; give 0 to leave the number of items on a page to the method, or a number from 1
path.api-key-id.scope the API key ID is scope, which names the route of the scope of the API key, not a key; pass the ID of an API key
path.segment.dot the path parameter is . or .., which would change the route; pass the key or ID of the object
path.segment.empty the path parameter is empty; pass the key or ID of the object
scope.environment.missing the operation acts on an environment, and the client's scope has none; pass WithScope(project, environment) to New
scope.project.missing the operation acts on a project, and the client's scope has none; pass WithScope(project, environment) to New
wait-for-sync.facts-via-api the call waits for sync, which only the PDP container does, and the client sends facts to the API; pass WithFactsViaPDP to New, or make the call without the wait
wait-for-sync.not-waiting the PDP container does not wait for sync on this route; make the call without the wait
wait-for-sync.policy.unknown the policy of the wait for sync is neither SyncPolicyFail nor SyncPolicyIgnore; pass one of them to WithSyncPolicy, or leave the option out to leave the policy to the PDP container
wait-for-sync.timeout-negative the timeout of the wait for sync is less than zero; give 0 or more
